name: Sales 24h Delta
summary: What changed in the sales workbook in the last 24 hours.
description: Sales 24h Delta watches the newest workbook under ${workspace}/reports/, diffs its rows against the snapshot taken about 24 hours ago, and shows the delta plus the rows that changed. Every card carries the as-of time and the source state; when the workbook is missing the card names the setting it needs instead of showing a zero.
highlights: Delta plus new, removed, and seen row counts for the last 24 hours.
Changed-row list links the delta to the deals that actually moved.
Watches ${workspace}/reports/*.xlsx with no plugin code or network.
